svg.title: Mean revenue by weekday
svg.desc: Monday to Thursday are highest, Sunday lower, and Saturday is near zero because the store is closed.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saturday is a structural zero — the store is closed, so MAPE is scored on non-zero days only
